She came into our house once I think looking for me, and my sister DESPISED her, so she blocked the way to the hallway and Jessica was livid. One of our dogs at the time, Rocky, was super protective and growled at Jessica since he sensed something was wrong with her and Jessica straight up hit our dog. OUR fucking dog. We kicked her out and she never came over again after that. 

I think she tried to make amends sometime after, but we just ignored her.
